diagnosis.spicy: Things get done. Some of them were load-bearing.
diagnosis.boardroom: Things get done. Occasionally one of them was load-bearing.

strength.spicy: You end stalemates. Rooms that have been circling for a week move when you arrive.
strength.boardroom: You break deadlocks. Situations that have stalled tend to move when you engage.

watch_out.spicy: You find out what something was for by breaking it. Ask first. Once.
watch_out.boardroom: You often discover a thing's purpose by removing it. Ask once before acting.

diagnosis.spicy: You solve problems nobody asked you to solve. Rarely the one you were given.
diagnosis.boardroom: You solve problems that were not assigned to you. Less often the one that was.

strength.spicy: You spot the actual bottleneck while everyone else is arguing about the agenda.
strength.boardroom: You identify the real constraint while others are still discussing process.

watch_out.spicy: Your open tabs are all someone else's job. Close one of yours today.
watch_out.boardroom: Much of your active work belongs to others. Close one of your own items first.

diagnosis.spicy: Nobody's quite sure how much you do. Including you.
diagnosis.boardroom: The volume of your output is not widely understood. Including by you.

strength.spicy: You move fast and land things softly. Very rare combination, genuinely valuable.
strength.boardroom: You act quickly while managing how it lands — an unusual and valuable combination.

watch_out.spicy: Invisible work gets counted as no work. Say what you finished.
watch_out.boardroom: Unreported work is treated as absent. State what you have completed.

diagnosis.spicy: Beautiful start. Thrilling middle. The end is somewhere in your drafts folder.
diagnosis.boardroom: Strong openings and compelling delivery. Completion is less consistent.

strength.spicy: You get people to care about something that doesn't exist yet. That's a real skill.
strength.boardroom: You build support for work that does not yet exist. That is a genuine capability.

watch_out.spicy: Enthusiasm is a promise. Unfinished ones get remembered.
watch_out.boardroom: Enthusiasm creates expectation. Unmet expectations are remembered.

diagnosis.spicy: You move fast by asking fast. Efficient, until you've asked four people the same thing.
diagnosis.boardroom: You move quickly by consulting quickly. Efficient, provided the consultation is not duplicated.

strength.spicy: Nothing sits in your queue getting stale. You route things.
strength.boardroom: Work does not stagnate with you. You route it effectively.

watch_out.spicy: Ten minutes on your own first. Most of the questions answer themselves.
watch_out.boardroom: Attempt it alone for ten minutes first. Many questions resolve themselves.

diagnosis.spicy: Extremely bright, extremely fast, briefly. Then everyone looks around for the next one.
diagnosis.boardroom: High energy and high impact in short bursts, with limited follow-through.

strength.spicy: You start things other people were too sensible to start.
strength.boardroom: You initiate work others consider too risky to begin.

watch_out.spicy: Starting is the fun bit. Finishing is the bit that counts.
watch_out.boardroom: Initiation is the enjoyable phase. Completion is the phase that is measured.

diagnosis.spicy: You get it over the line and you got seven people to help. They didn't mind.
diagnosis.boardroom: You deliver, and you mobilise others to help. They tend not to mind.

strength.spicy: You use the whole building. Most people never work out they're allowed to.
strength.boardroom: You draw on the whole organisation. Many people never realise they may.

watch_out.spicy: Sometimes the answer is you, alone, for twenty minutes.
watch_out.boardroom: Occasionally the answer is twenty minutes of your own focused work.

diagnosis.boardroom: Considerable simultaneous investment in a number of unfinished things.

strength.spicy: You raise the temperature of a room in a good way. Teams need one of you.
strength.boardroom: You raise energy in a room constructively. Teams benefit from having one.

watch_out.spicy: Pick three. Close the other nine. It'll hurt for an hour.
watch_out.boardroom: Choose three priorities and close the rest.

diagnosis.boardroom: A genuinely difficult person to compete with.

strength.spicy: You plan it, try it yourself, say it straight, and finish it. There isn't a gap to exploit.
strength.boardroom: You plan, attempt, communicate clearly and complete. There is little exposure.

watch_out.spicy: You're hard to help. People stop offering, and eventually stop telling you things.
watch_out.boardroom: You are difficult to assist, and people may stop offering — and stop volunteering information.

diagnosis.spicy: Magnificent plans. Someone else is going to build them.
diagnosis.boardroom: Excellent planning, with delivery frequently left to others.

strength.spicy: You see the whole shape before anyone else. That saves entire quarters.
strength.boardroom: You see the full structure early, which can save considerable time.

watch_out.spicy: A plan nobody executed is a document.
watch_out.boardroom: An unexecuted plan is only a document.

diagnosis.spicy: It always arrives, it's always right, and nobody knows it was hard.
diagnosis.boardroom: Work arrives on time and correct, and the difficulty is rarely visible.

strength.spicy: You are the person things get given to when it actually matters.
strength.boardroom: You are trusted with work when the stakes are high.

watch_out.spicy: Reliable people get more work, not more credit. Ask for the credit.
watch_out.boardroom: Reliability attracts volume rather than recognition. Ask for the recognition.

diagnosis.spicy: You've thought about it beautifully from every angle and told nobody the conclusion.
diagnosis.boardroom: You have considered it thoroughly from every angle without communicating the conclusion.

strength.spicy: Your read of a situation is usually right, and usually early.
strength.boardroom: Your assessment of a situation is generally accurate and generally early.

watch_out.spicy: An unshared insight scores zero. Say it in the meeting, not after.
watch_out.boardroom: An unshared insight has no effect. Raise it during the meeting.

diagnosis.spicy: You check, you confirm, you deliver, and you have receipts for all of it.
diagnosis.boardroom: You verify, confirm, deliver, and maintain a clear record throughout.

strength.spicy: Nothing goes missing on your watch. Extremely underrated.
strength.boardroom: Nothing is lost under your management. This is consistently undervalued.

watch_out.spicy: Confirming everything reads as not deciding anything. Decide the small ones.
watch_out.boardroom: Confirming everything can appear as an absence of decision. Decide the minor items yourself.

diagnosis.spicy: Superb diagnosis, delivered clearly, then handed to someone else with a smile.
diagnosis.boardroom: Strong diagnosis, clearly communicated, then passed on for delivery.

strength.spicy: You can explain a mess to people who caused it without a fight breaking out.
strength.boardroom: You can explain a problem to those responsible for it without escalation.

watch_out.spicy: Own one all the way to the end this quarter. Just one.
watch_out.boardroom: Take one item through to completion yourself this quarter.

diagnosis.spicy: Everyone is consulted, everyone is comfortable, and somehow it still ships.
diagnosis.boardroom: Everyone is consulted and comfortable, and delivery still occurs.

strength.spicy: You get difficult groups to agree. That's most of management, done early.
strength.boardroom: You build agreement among difficult groups — much of management, done early.

watch_out.spicy: Consensus takes time you sometimes don't have. Some calls are just yours.
watch_out.boardroom: Consensus is time-expensive. Some decisions are simply yours to take.

diagnosis.spicy: You have considered every angle and started nothing.
diagnosis.boardroom: You have considered every angle and have not yet begun.

strength.spicy: You catch the risk everyone else waved through. That's worth a lot, once things are moving.
strength.boardroom: You identify risks others accept without scrutiny — valuable, once work is in motion.

watch_out.spicy: The plan is not the work. Do the smallest real version this week.
watch_out.boardroom: Planning is not delivery. Complete the smallest real version this week.
